_note: The parts of the capital-gains head, each with the term of the gains it collects and whether a long-term loss may be set off against it (D-309). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.108(2)(b) (p.147): "(b) any long-term capital asset is a loss, such loss shall be set off against the income computed in respect of any other long-term capital asset for that year"; s.111(1)(a)(ii) (p.148), the loss carried forward, long-term "only against … any other long-term capital asset". TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.70(3), as substituted by the Finance Act, 2002 s.27 (Goa reprint p.1375; thc copy p.318), and s.74(1), as substituted by the Finance Act, 2002 s.29, the same restriction. A short-term loss may be set off against any part (s.108(2)(a); s.70(2)), so only the long-term restriction is declared. The year's own set-off is SETOFF-WITHIN-CAPITAL-GAINS's and the carried loss's SETOFF-CARRIED-CAPITAL-GAINS's; each reads this row for the parts a long-term loss reaches and the term of a part's loss. Which bucket falls in which part is RS-CG-PART's (D-289); the term codes are those its rows test as capitalgains.term. The provisions, introducedBy and provenance are SETOFF-WITHIN-CAPITAL-GAINS's; the carried restriction's are SETOFF-CARRIED-CAPITAL-GAINS's.
